We recently worked with JDI Construction and Remodeling for a remodel on our personal home, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every way.

From start to finish, the level of professionalism, organization, and craftsmanship was outstanding. What truly set JDI apart was their communication and coordination throughout the entire project. They were incredibly helpful in managing schedules, subcontractors, materials, and every moving part of the process, which made what could have been a stressful remodel feel smooth and well-controlled.

They were responsive, transparent, and proactive — always keeping us informed and addressing questions promptly. The attention to detail and quality of work reflect a true high-end contractor who takes pride in delivering exceptional results.

If you’re looking for a contractor who combines expert craftsmanship with excellent project management and communication, I would highly recommend JDI Construction and Remodeling. We wouldn’t hesitate to work with them again.

Had a great experience with JDI Construction.
Definitely a reputable team. Highly recommend them. They definitely know what they are doing. Also very knowledgeable. Thank you.
Mark Pavliuk
Portland, OR · Sep 2026
View on Google
★★★★★
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Amazing Experience!
When we purchased our home in La Center, the downstairs only had two rooms and one bathroom. Upstairs had three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a kitchen, and a mudroom. We knew we wanted to transform the downstairs into a comfortable living space for my mother-in-law, and finding the right contractor was extremely important to us.
That’s when we hired Art and his team, and honestly, we could not have asked for a better person to work with.
From our very first meeting, Art was friendly, patient, an incredible listener, and truly understood what we wanted. He took the time to sit down with us, go through the entire remodeling process, discuss the timeline and pricing, and answer all of our questions. We had multiple meetings throughout the project, and his communication and follow-up were outstanding.
His team did an amazing job. Everything downstairs was completely transformed. They remodeled the existing bathroom, added another beautiful bathroom with a gorgeous shower, relocated and redesigned the space to create a master-style room, and even added a full kitchen downstairs.
What started as a downstairs area became essentially an ADU for my mother-in-law. ❤️ It has made our family life so much easier. Grandma can comfortably have her own space downstairs while our family lives upstairs, but we are still all under one roof.
What impressed us most was how involved Art was throughout the entire process. He went with us to select tile and countertops, helped us make decisions, made sure the pricing was fair, and personally followed up to make sure everything was done correctly. Even after the project was completed, he continued checking in with Grandma to make sure she was doing well. His team has continued to be just as caring.
That level of care is something you don’t always find.
Our home is beautiful, completely remodeled, and feels brand new. More importantly, we’re grateful to have found someone who cared about our family—not just the project.
Art and his entire team, thank you from the bottom of our hearts. We are truly thankful and blessed to have had you remodel our home. ❤️
If you are thinking about remodeling your home, I highly recommend giving Art and his team a call. You won’t just be hiring a contractor—you’ll be working with people who genuinely care about doing a great job and making sure you’re happy. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Once we started Eugene was the Project Manager and communicated with us daily through out the project. Most often he would stop by at least once a day. Alex did most of the work including the tile. I would definitely use them again for a a remodel project.

Vancouver, WA · May 2026

★★★★★
We recently worked with JDI Construction and Remodeling for a remodel on our personal home, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every way.

From start to finish, the level of professionalism, organization, and craftsmanship was outstanding. What truly set JDI apart was their communication and coordination throughout the entire project. They were incredibly helpful in managing schedules, subcontractors, materials, and every moving part of the process, which made what could have been a stressful remodel feel smooth and well-controlled.

They were responsive, transparent, and proactive — always keeping us informed and addressing questions promptly. The attention to detail and quality of work reflect a true high-end contractor who takes pride in delivering exceptional results.

If you’re looking for a contractor who combines expert craftsmanship with excellent project management and communication, I would highly recommend JDI Construction and Remodeling. We wouldn’t hesitate to work with them again.

Modern Kitchen Remodel in Vancouver, WA 98661
6 Photos
Mediterranean-Inspired Kitchen with Teal Tile and Hand-Painted Spanish Mural in Vancouver, WA

This Vancouver, WA kitchen remodel by JDI Construction leans into character without leaning costume — natural-wood shaker cabinetry, a glossy teal handmade tile backsplash, and a hand-painted Spanish-style tile mural over the range that gives the room a clear, confident focal point.

The cabinets are custom shaker doors in a warm natural wood finish, running consistently along the perimeter, on the island base, and up into a built-in china hutch. Slim brushed nickel bar pulls keep the hardware quiet against the warm wood, letting the tile and the appliances carry the visual energy of the room.

Above counter, glossy teal subway tile in an offset pattern wraps the cooking wall and the sink wall. Centered above the stainless range and below the stainless chimney hood, a hand-painted Spanish-style ceramic tile mural in blues, yellows, and burnt orange becomes the room's centerpiece — a moment of pattern and color in an otherwise restrained palette. White quartz countertops keep the surfaces clean and let the backsplash speak.

The island is finished in the same warm wood with a white quartz top and decorative wood corbels at the corners, paired with tan leather counter stools and three faceted seeded-glass cone pendants overhead. Bamboo roman shades, a stainless French-door refrigerator, and a built-in china hutch round out a kitchen remodel that reads as personal, not catalog-driven.

Key Features
Natural-wood custom shaker cabinetry across perimeter, island, and built-in china hutch
Glossy handmade teal subway tile backsplash
Hand-painted Spanish-style ceramic tile mural over the range
White quartz countertops on perimeter and island
Stainless slide-in range, chimney hood, and French-door refrigerator
Decorative wood corbels at the island corners
Faceted seeded-glass cone pendants over the island

★★★★★
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Amazing Experience!
When we purchased our home in La Center, the downstairs only had two rooms and one bathroom. Upstairs had three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a kitchen, and a mudroom. We knew we wanted to transform the downstairs into a comfortable living space for my mother-in-law, and finding the right contractor was extremely important to us.
That’s when we hired Art and his team, and honestly, we could not have asked for a better person to work with.
From our very first meeting, Art was friendly, patient, an incredible listener, and truly understood what we wanted. He took the time to sit down with us, go through the entire remodeling process, discuss the timeline and pricing, and answer all of our questions. We had multiple meetings throughout the project, and his communication and follow-up were outstanding.
His team did an amazing job. Everything downstairs was completely transformed. They remodeled the existing bathroom, added another beautiful bathroom with a gorgeous shower, relocated and redesigned the space to create a master-style room, and even added a full kitchen downstairs.
What started as a downstairs area became essentially an ADU for my mother-in-law. ❤️ It has made our family life so much easier. Grandma can comfortably have her own space downstairs while our family lives upstairs, but we are still all under one roof.
What impressed us most was how involved Art was throughout the entire process. He went with us to select tile and countertops, helped us make decisions, made sure the pricing was fair, and personally followed up to make sure everything was done correctly. Even after the project was completed, he continued checking in with Grandma to make sure she was doing well. His team has continued to be just as caring.
That level of care is something you don’t always find.
Our home is beautiful, completely remodeled, and feels brand new. More importantly, we’re grateful to have found someone who cared about our family—not just the project.
Art and his entire team, thank you from the bottom of our hearts. We are truly thankful and blessed to have had you remodel our home. ❤️
If you are thinking about remodeling your home, I highly recommend giving Art and his team a call. You won’t just be hiring a contractor—you’ll be working with people who genuinely care about doing a great job and making sure you’re happy. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Hadas Metzler

I worked with Craft Home Remodeling on several large scale projects. Joey, the owner, is extremely professional, he knows construction better than anyone and is very familiar with San Diego building style. Pricing is competitive. I would highly recommend working with Joey on any renovation project large or small.

read more
Bonita Wehrhan

Joey and his team transformed our bathrooms into beautiful, modern spaces. He has good eye for helping his clients bring their vision to reality. I know that without his guidance we would not have had such an amazing outcome without him. If you want a designer space without paying for a designer, hire Joey!! He is very organized and keeps the project on schedule. And in addition, he's just a nice guy to work with.

read more
Brandon Bailey

Craft Home Remodeling recently completed our kitchen renovation and they hit it out of the park. We couldn't be happier. They delivered us the kitchen of our dreams and the compliments we've received so far are a testament to their skills. They are a team of complete pro's that made sure to deliver us exactly what we were promised with zero compromises. The owner, Joey, worked with me for close to a year on the details, he was patient, helpful, and caring. He's among the most honest and reasonable men that I've done business with and I certainly expect to use his team in the future. I highly recommend Craft Home Remodeling — they are hands down the best value for your money.

read more
Patrick Leung

This was our first home remodel and things can get quite stressful. We remodeled our entire home and Joey and his team helped walked us through the entire process and put us at ease. We met with multiple contractors for quotes prior, and it was clear from the start that Joey stood head and shoulders above the others. He is able to guide and give his opinions, while respecting your choices. Couldn't imagine anyone better to work with. He also has a great eye for aesthetics, just look at his portfolio compared to others.

Welcome to Craft Home Remodeling!

Craft Home Remodeling is the brainchild of Joey Dahan, a visionary dedicated to elevating customer service in the remodeling industry. With a deep-rooted passion for bringing joy and satisfaction to families in our hometown of San Diego, Joey founded this venture on the belief that homes are more than just spaces; they’re sanctuaries where memories are woven.

Our spirit revolves around more than just erecting walls and roofs. Craft Home Remodeling is based on the belief that a home is a canvas for dreams to unfold, a sanctuary where every detail contributes to a harmonious blend of aesthetics and functionality. As dedicated craftsmen, we take pride in translating aspirations into tangible realities, ensuring that every corner of your abode resonates with your unique vision and personality.

Here at Craft Home Remodels, we don’t just construct houses; we are passionate artisans that are devoted to involved weaving dreams into the very fabric of your home. Our mission extends beyond the traditions of home building, enclosing a commitment to transforming spaces into living narratives of comfort, style, and individuality. Your journey towards a home that is not just a physical structure but a personalized haven begins right here, at the intersection where craftsmanship seamlessly converges with boundless creativity.

Welcome to Craft

Tailored Elegance

Welcome to Craft Home Remodeling’s Bathroom Remodels service, where we transcend ordinary bathrooms into extraordinary personal sanctuaries. Your bathroom is not just a functional space; it’s a retreat, a place dedicated to unwinding and rejuvenation. Our team of skilled artisans is here to transform your bathroom dreams into a tangible reality.

Our approach to bathroom Remodels revolves around the concept of tailored elegance. We believe that every detail matters, from the choice of tiles to the placement of fixtures. Whether you envision a contemporary spa-like oasis or a classic, timeless design, our experts collaborate closely with you to bring your unique vision to life. Our commitment is to prioritize functionality without compromising on style, ensuring that your new bathroom is a perfect blend of form and function.

San Diego's Most Trusted Contractor

Q.& A.

Before Your Bathroom Remodel
Why should I consider remodeling my bathroom?

Bathroom remodeling can elevate both functionality and aesthetics. It's an opportunity to create a relaxing sanctuary that meets your needs and reflects your personal style.

How do I determine my budget for a bathroom remodel?

Assess your financial situation and priorities. Consider the scale of renovations, materials, fixtures, and any additional features. Factor in a contingency fund for unexpected expenses.

What factors should I consider when choosing a remodeling service for my bathroom?

Look for experienced professionals with a proven track record in bathroom remodels. Consider their expertise, customer reviews, and ability to work within your budget and timeline.

How can I prepare for the planning and design stage of the bathroom remodel?

Define your goals and priorities. Collect design inspirations, create a list of must-haves, and communicate openly with your design team to optimize the layout and functionality.

What are common challenges during a bathroom remodel, and how can they be mitigated?

Challenges may include plumbing issues, unexpected structural problems, or material delays. A detailed contract, proper planning, and working with experienced professionals help anticipate and address these challenges.

How can I minimize disruption during the bathroom remodeling process?

Establish a clear timeline with your remodeling team, create alternative bathing arrangements if necessary, and communicate your daily routines to plan construction phases accordingly.

What are some popular features or trends to consider for a modern bathroom remodel?

Features such as walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, smart fixtures, and energy-efficient lighting are popular. However, timeless designs that align with your personal taste are equally important.

How long does a typical bathroom remodel take?

The duration varies based on the scope of the project. A simple update may take a few weeks, while a more extensive remodel can take several weeks to a few months. Clear communication with your remodeling team is crucial for managing expectations.

How can I ensure my remodeled bathroom suits my lifestyle and needs?

Communicate openly with your design team, sharing your daily routines, storage needs, and any specific requirements. This ensures the final design is practical and enhances your lifestyle.

What's the best way to maintain the longevity of my remodeled bathroom?

Follow proper maintenance guidelines for fixtures, materials, and ventilation. Regular cleaning, addressing issues promptly, and scheduling periodic inspections contribute to the longevity of your remodeled bathroom.

Our mission extends beyond the traditions of home building, enclosing a commitment to transforming spaces into living narratives of comfort, style, and individuality. Our Journey

Welcome to Craft Home Remodeling! Craft Home Remodeling is the brainchild of Joey Dahan, a visionary dedicated to elevating customer service in the remodeling industry. With a deep-rooted passion for bringing joy and satisfaction to families in our hometown of San Diego, Joey founded this venture on the belief that homes are more than just spaces; they’re sanctuaries where memories are woven.

Driven by a fervor for customer-centric service, Craft Home Remodeling was born from Joey’s desire to redefine remodeling experiences. His journey began with a commitment to bring delight and fulfillment to every family through thoughtfully designed remodels.
